# Allenservice (آلن سرویس)

> Allenservice is an espresso-machine repair workshop and specialty shop in Khomein, Iran (Chaharrah-e Qods), run by Mohammad Akbari with 3 years of experience on industrial and home espresso machines. Repairs are done in the workshop only (no on-site repair). New and used machines are sold and shipped from Bandar Genaveh, Iran. The site publishes a photo price list of spare parts, machines and grinders for sale, and free exploded-diagram PDFs for dozens of espresso machine and grinder brands.

## Services

- Industrial espresso machine repair — 3-month warranty on mechanical parts
- Home espresso machine repair — 7-day warranty on parts and descaling service
- Espresso machine spare parts with photos and prices (IRR)
- New and used espresso machines and coffee grinders for sale
- Free exploded diagrams (PDF) for 34 espresso machine brands and 11 grinder brands
- Persian-language repair guides and buying guides
